units.previous_finding: The Fetch documentation comment mistranslates the return-value relationship. "Fetch returns the body of URL and a slice of URLs found on that page" becomes "Fetch, इसका बॉडी लौटाता है: URL और ...", which is grammatically broken and can imply that URL itself is a returned item rather than the body of that URL. Revise the comment to state clearly that Fetch returns the URL body and a slice of URLs found on that page, while preserving all identifiers and code.

The comment preserves the meaning of "a function that returns a function that returns an int", but "जो लौटाता है एक ऐसा फ़ंक्शन" has noticeably unnatural Hindi word order. Revise it into a complete natural Hindi sentence while preserving fibonacci and int as technical identities and keeping the code unchanged.
